glosses: Of a weapon: used in close-range combat, e.g. a sword. Compare with ranged.

examples.text: A melee weapon is used to attack a target within 5 feet of you, whereas a ranged weapon is used to attack a target at a distance.

examples.text: Honestly, a lot of what this episode did right had more to do with the scenes that surrounded the enormous melee than those hyper-edited clashes of swords.
